stages.title: Start with Your Idea.
stages.intro: A logo, a reference or a photo of the space is enough to begin the discussion.
stages.input: Sign in with Google or verify your email, then add your contact number, intended use and delivery destination.
stages.work: We review the starting information and clarify the style, size, quantity and any open requirements with you.
stages.result: A saved enquiry and a clear starting point for your project.

stages.title: Resolve the Details. Review Your Quote.
stages.intro: Bring the artwork, construction and supplied scope together before the order moves forward.
stages.input: Share available dimensions, site photos and colour or finish references. Tell us what is still provisional.
stages.work: We review the artwork, materials, lighting, fixing and delivery requirements, then prepare a project-based quote.
stages.result: Review the specification, price, inclusions and order terms. Approve the agreed requirements in writing before production.

stages.title: Made to the Agreed Specification.
stages.intro: The approved details guide fabrication, finishing and the checks required for your sign.
stages.input: Confirm the inspection points and any photos, records or documentation required with your order.
stages.work: We make your sign to the confirmed requirements and carry out the agreed appearance, construction and lighting checks where applicable.
stages.result: Complete the agreed order checks and confirm the packing and dispatch arrangements.

stages.title: Protected for the Journey. Prepared for Your Site.
stages.intro: Plan the packing, shipment and local installation together, before dispatch.
stages.input: Confirm the delivery address, local installation arrangements and any access or documentation needs.
stages.work: We prepare the agreed protection and shipment arrangements, and confirm the supplied installation information.
stages.result: Know the shipping scope, timing and import responsibilities. Resolve local fixing, electrical work and approvals with your installer.

faq: Can I start with only a logo or a reference photo?
Yes. Sign in and share what you have. A finished technical drawing is not required to begin the discussion; the final artwork and construction requirements must be confirmed before production.
What if I do not know the size or sign style yet?

Choose not sure in the enquiry form. A photo of the space, the approximate available area and how the sign will be viewed help us discuss a suitable direction. Final dimensions must be confirmed for the order.

We quote for the design, dimensions, materials, lighting, quantity and delivery scope. Review the currency, included components, shipping costs, assumptions, exclusions and validity conditions in your quotation.
Can I enquire about one sign?
Tell us the number of complete signs you need, including a single sign. We will review the construction, feasibility and project price for your requirement.
How long will production and shipping take?

Tell us your destination and any target arrival or opening date. Production and transit schedules are confirmed for the actual specification and shipping arrangement; an enquiry does not reserve a delivery date.
Can I change the design after approval?

Contact us promptly with the requested change. We will confirm whether it is possible and whether price or timing changes at the current production stage. A requested change takes effect only when agreed.

Confirm local installation, fixing, electrical connection and any permissions with your installer. Tell us which templates, drawings or other installation information you need so the available scope can be agreed before production.
What should I do if something arrives damaged or incorrect?
Keep the packaging and photograph the issue. Contact us promptly with the order reference and relevant images so the issue can be reviewed under the agreed order and support arrangements.
